notes: Spots are limited. Lead MANTIS needs 2 or more years of MANTIS experience.
name: MANTIS Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens ages 14 to 17 who enjoy bugs, nature and kids and families. Interviews and an in person orientation are required.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 who like bugs, nature and working with kids and families. Must attend in-person orientation and training. Interviews are required.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Training is provided. Lead MANTIS volunteers get a Friends and Family membership.
duration: June to August, at least 30 hours (Lead MANTIS 40 hours)
deadline_text: 2026: apply by Apr 10, group interviews Apr 18 or 19, Lead MANTIS orientation May 28. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online in spring, then go to a group interview. Questions: butterflyhouse@mobot.org.
